basis: Read-only frozen payload and already-downloaded actual log, no GPU/network/weight download or throughput experiment

observed.warning: 60-second worker snapshots and repeated raw_log_tail do not timestamp actual loader/base-validation/reference stages. The 4-second progress bar may cover only its own loop. No stage timing inferred from GPU utilization.

io_sequence.mechanism: Each 8MiB block is read once, written once and fed to file SHA256 before the next block. There is no separate mount hash pass.
Manifest provenance, stat sizes, small config SHA and manifest SHA only.
Model materialization reads local safetensors. Exact OS block read counts/cache hits were not observed.

io_sequence.source: verified local copy and actual post-attachment GPU tensors
io_sequence.mechanism: For every mapped tensor: expected CPU tensor from local shard and loaded actual tensor; full numeric SHA on each, semantic packed QuantState JSON comparison, small RMSNorm cast exception. GPU-to-CPU loaded bytes must still be checked.

excluded_shortcuts: Skipping copy and loading directly from the slow mount would expose both loader and expected-tensor comparison to mount reads; zero-copy is not an observed speedup.
The expected-tensor hash is not redundant with actual-loaded tensor comparison; file SHA alone cannot prove loader or PEFT preserves frozen tensors.
No present evidence assigns the unlogged time solely to base verification or proves that parallel shard reads improve this mount.

concrete_candidates_not_implemented.change: Add bounded phase timing around Unsloth import, FastModel load, adapter load, actual-base validation and reference completion in a new explicitly frozen diagnostic source.
concrete_candidates_not_implemented.benefit: Attribute the real remaining budget without guessing from repeated progress-bar tails.

concrete_candidates_not_implemented.change: Produce a version-bound per-tensor expected-identity sidecar on CPU from the original shards; bind index/manifest/file SHA, names, shapes/dtypes, raw numeric hashes, canonical QuantState metadata and allowable small BF16-to-FP32 cast hashes. Validate actual loaded tensors against it after adapter attachment.
concrete_candidates_not_implemented.work_removed: Expected-tensor local payload reread and expected CPU hashing during the GPU session; preserves full actual GPU-to-CPU numeric verification.
concrete_candidates_not_implemented.conditions: CPU producer must actually compute the sidecar from original SHA-matching shards, with exact binding and unchanged name/dtype/norm rules. No trusting an unbound digest file.

concrete_candidates_not_implemented.change: Overlap the isolated model worker library import with the coordinator one-pass copy, while delaying all model/cache reads until copy verification finishes using a bounded handoff.
concrete_candidates_not_implemented.work_removed: Serial import-before-model time can overlap mount I/O; no extra mount reads or relaxed byte identity.
concrete_candidates_not_implemented.conditions: Keep import ordering, fresh worker, original budget ownership and early worker failure handling. CPU/I/O contention may erase the benefit.
